# BuildSignals

> BuildSignals books in-home appointments for bathroom remodeling contractors in the United States. BuildSignals pays for the ads, calls every new lead in under 5 minutes and books the appointment on the remodeler's calendar with every decision-maker home. Remodelers pay $297 for each appointment where the homeowner sits down with them, and no-shows are free. One bathroom remodeler per area. No long-term contracts. Contractor clients have closed $2.8M+ in remodeling work. Founded by Leo Melaye in 2016; based in Davis, California.

## The offer

- $297 per sat appointment: the remodeler sits down in the home with the homeowner and every decision-maker. Ad spend is included.
- Not billed: no-shows, cancellations, reschedules, one-legs (only one decision-maker home), appointments the remodeler chooses not to run, and homeowners already in the remodeler's CRM in the last 90 days.
- Prepaid balance: each sat appointment comes off it. The starting amount is set on the first call. Stop any time with 7 days' notice and the unused balance is refunded.
- 10x guarantee: if the jobs signed from the first 20 sits add up to less than 10 times what was paid for them ($59,400) within 90 days, BuildSignals adds 10 sits free.
- One bathroom remodeler per area, in writing.
- CRM integration is free. For remodelers without a CRM, BuildSignals builds one for $1,500.

## What BuildSignals does

- Writes, designs, pays for and runs Facebook and Instagram ads in the remodeler's service area
- Calls every new lead in under 5 minutes and screens it against the remodeler's criteria
- Books appointments on the remodeler's calendar and confirms every decision-maker will be home
- Sends every lead and call recording into the remodeler's CRM

## Who it is for

- Bathroom remodeling companies of any size in the United States, from owner-operators to teams with several sales reps
- Bathroom work: full remodels, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in showers and tubs, and bath replacements

## Results

- $2.8M+ in remodeling work closed by contractor clients to date
- MTR Baths (Dillon McEwin): $275,000 closed this year on $16,000 in ads
- Valencia Construction Pros: $264,025 closed from 11 jobs since July 2026, on $4,380 in ads
- H. Flores Construction (Huver Flores): $63,299 closed from 5 jobs since July 2026, on $3,872 in ads
- Contractor 2.0 (Esteban Molina): first appointment 15 minutes after the ads went live, and a $22,000 job signed on day 10
- A Los Angeles remodeler: 71 booked bathroom appointments from BuildSignals ads in its first five weeks

## Common questions

- How much does BuildSignals cost? $297 for each appointment where the homeowner sits down with the remodeler. Ad spend is included, and no-shows are free.
- What counts as a sit? The remodeler is in the home with the homeowner and every decision-maker. No-shows, cancellations and reschedules don't count.
- How fast are leads called? Every new lead is called in under 5 minutes.
- Is there a contract? No long-term contract. Stop any time with 7 days' notice.
- Where does BuildSignals work? Across the United States, with one bathroom remodeler per area.
- How do I get started? Book a 30-minute call with Leo at https://buildsignals.com/#book, or call or text (213) 449-7226.
